[ASSISTANT_SAID] Project Idea: Smart Reservation System for Hotels

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Description: Develop a reservation system for hotels that allows users to search for available rooms, make bookings, and manage their reservations.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tech Stack: Microservices architecture, API Gateway, GraphQL, Distributed Database, Web Portal, Machine Learning.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Microservices: Each microservice can be responsible for a specific feature or functionality.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] API Gateway: Use an API gateway to provide a single entry point for clients, responsible for authentication, rate limiting, and routing requests.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] GraphQL: Create a flexible API that allows clients to specify the data they need, improving performance.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Distributed Database: Use Apache Cassandra or MongoDB for scalability and high availability.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Web Portal: Use Angular to build a responsive, accessible, and secure user interface.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Machine Learning: Use TensorFlow.js in one of the microservices to develop a recommendation engine based on user preferences and booking history.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional Features: Payment Gateway, Room Upgrades, Cancellation Policies.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Deployment: Use Docker to containerize microservices and the database.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kubernetes: Use Kubernetes to orchestrate containers and manage deployment.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment: Use Jenkins or another CI/CD tool for automation.
